rows.label: Mute everything
rows.hint: One switch; your volumes stay as they are

rows.label: Fullscreen
rows.hint: Same as the Fullscreen button; Alt+Enter in the desktop app

rows.label: Picture shape
rows.hint: The shape of the picture; the match goes on

rows.label: Fullscreen mouse
rows.hint: Browser only; holds the mouse inside the picture

rows.label: Ant health
rows.hint: Shows hit points: a bar over the ant, or a number at its lower right. Every ant has 10 at most.

rows.label: Show health as
rows.hint: A small bar over the ant, or a number at its lower right

words.title: Settings
words.note: The game keeps running while this menu is open.
words.noteReplay: The replay keeps playing. Pause it with the bar.
words.deciding: The game keeps running while you decide.

ask.title: Leave the game?
ask.body: This match ends. Your game is not saved.

ask.title: Leave the game?
ask.body: You will drop out. Your ants are lost, the others play on, and you cannot come back to this match.

ask.title: Forfeit and leave?
ask.body: You give up this match. It ends now for everybody and counts as a loss for you.

ask.title: Leave the game?
ask.body: The match is held. You leave it for good and cannot come back to this match.
